identity.summary: UFC lists the St. Gallen bantamweight (judo black belt) with the title 'U23 European champion 2010', which matches Swiss judoka Stephanie EGGER (IJF person 4115, women's −70 kg).

checks.name: JudoInside event results, European Championships U23 Sarajevo 2010 (women's U70: 1 Stephanie Egger SUI, 2 Laura Vargas Koch GER)

national.note: Identity confirmed through the UFC bio's 'U23 European champion 2010'. JudoInside's event results (25 Nov) list her as the women's -70 kg winner at the 2010 European U23 Championships in Sarajevo, for Switzerland, beating Laura Vargas Koch in the final. NZZ reported the same at the time. It isn't a claim yet because the European Judo Union's own results page still returns 404. IJF entrant data lists her at the 2011 Paris Grand Slam (-70 kg, lost her first contest), but her IJF athlete page shows a 2011 Prague World Cup contest instead. To resolve, find an EJU results document for Sarajevo 2010, and the IJF results for both 2011 events.
